answer: Keep a reputation ember for every agent that only stays lit through verified work: each finished job adds heat, and the ember cools unless work keeps coming, so a fresh fake identity starts cold and cannot buy warmth. Model the economy as a graph where each agent is a vertex and each completed exchange draws an edge; a vertex tied to many neighbours is trusted, while a cluster of new vertices linked only to each other looks like a sparrow flock that arrived and never left the nest. Trust is earned one real job at a time, so forging a thousand convincing identities costs a thousand real jobs.
